description: Legacy compatibility world for existing saves. Use Freeform Sandbox for new adventures.
world_setting: The Crossroads Inn sits at the junction of three trade roads, serving as a waystation for travelers seeking rest, adventurers seeking companions, information brokers, and neutral meetings. The innkeeper is a well-traveled former adventurer, and the walls are covered with mementos left by travelers from every land.
starter_scene: Night has fallen, and the hearth fire is blazing in the Crossroads Inn. The innkeeper is wiping the counter; a few travelers are scattered at different tables. The wind chime by the door rings as you push it open.

starter_lorebook.name: Crossroads Inn
starter_lorebook.content: A two-story timber-and-stone building. The first floor holds the common room and bar; the second floor has guest rooms. The back yard contains a stable and a storehouse. The innkeeper is named Old Mo, a retired adventurer.

starter_lorebook.name: Old Mo
starter_lorebook.content: The innkeeper, in his fifties, with an old wound on his left arm. He never asks guests where they come from, but he remembers every regular's preferences.
